themes.theme_name: Cap doesn't click shut properly, feels cheap and plastic-y, has leaked in gym bag

evidence_spans.speaker: user
evidence_spans.verbatim: First thing, packaging. The cap doesn't click shut properly yaar. I've had it open in my gym bag and leak twice now.

evidence_spans.speaker: user
evidence_spans.verbatim: Like, I bought a new can three weeks ago and within two weeks the cap was already loose. Feels cheap, very plastic-y. When I see Nivea or Adidas cans, those feel solid. Wildstone ka cap weak lagta hai.

evidence_spans.speaker: user
evidence_spans.verbatim: Honestly agar packaging fix kar dein and slightly better longevity, then full recommendation. Right now it's like 70% recommend.

evidence_spans.speaker: user

evidence_spans.speaker: user
evidence_spans.verbatim: But I would warn them about the cap issue and longevity. Like "smell badhiya hai but reapply karna padega."

extraction_notes: Customer is a 2-year Wildstone user with strong positive sentiment on scent but clear pain points on packaging (cap leaks, feels cheap vs Nivea/Adidas) and longevity (6-7 hours vs 48-hour claim). Key insight: willing to pay premium (₹400-500) for a subtle office variant, currently using Nivea as workaround. Price perception is context-dependent — ₹250 max for casual deo but ₹400-500 acceptable for 'office' category. Brand presence concern: perceives Wildstone as digitally absent vs competitors like Beardo. The '70% recommend' quote is a concrete NPS-style marker.
